title: Bias and Walsh expectations
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho$ be a probability density on $\bbr_2^n$, and let $\varepsilon\in\bbr$. The absolute values of all nonzero vector Fourier coefficients of $\rho$ are at most $\varepsilon$ if and only if, for every nonzero $\gamma\in\bbr_2^n$, the absolute value of the expectation under $\rho$ of the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: the bound is required for every nonzero $\gamma\in\bbr_2^n$
